q1.explanationZh: 开头说一位年轻记者来向作者请教，说明作者是个有经验、受人尊敬的记者。

evidence.quote: a young journalist asked me if I had any tips for him

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说作者毕业以后，才发现校外的聪明读者不要大词，要把大想法说简单。

evidence.quote: Then I graduated and realised that smart readers outside the classroom don’t want big words.

q3.explanationZh: 第二段说大词太多，读者会觉得作者在炫耀，或者怀疑他自己没弄懂，对应 ② 和 ④。

evidence.quote: too many big words can send a signal to some readers that the writer is showing off or doesn’t fully understand what he or she is saying

q4.explanationZh: 第四段讲“写出音乐感”。肯尼迪的话很有节奏，容易让人记住，作者用它说明节奏怎样帮助记忆。

q5.explanationZh: 作者分享了三条写作的黄金法则，目的是帮助大家提高写作水平。

evidence.quote: I shared three golden rules that have guided me whenever I write
